script_text: Something is whispering through your inbox tonight, and it is not a glitch — it is Mercury, awake in the shadows. Mercury Retrograde is the messenger planet, ruler of Gemini and the airy intellect, sliding backward through Sagittarius, slowing your 3rd House of communication to a crawl. Its shadow touches travel, siblings, and every spoken promise. Expect delayed texts, misunderstood emails, and an old flame resurfacing through your 7th House of love before November ends. In career, Mercury square Pluto warns: never sign a contract, loan, or lease this week, yet Venus trine your income axis means calm renegotiation raises your pay. This Retrograde asks you to face Chiron's oldest wound, while the North Node insists that avoided conversation is the one that heals. Back up every file, reread every message, speak slowly tonight. Comment your sign for your personal transit reading.
